free_text: A repeat biopsy is indicated due to the high-risk PI-RADS score of 5 on the MRI and a rising PSA trend from 1.0 ng/mL to 3.9 ng/mL. Although the prior biopsy grade was not recorded, the combination of a high-risk imaging finding and rising PSA trajectory necessitates further histological clarification. The evidence converged on the need for a repeat biopsy to determine the current disease status.
